## STRICT RULES

* Do NOT implement frontend or mobile

* Do NOT bypass security

### LIQUIBASE RULE

- All database changes MUST follow your agreed database migration standard
- When evolving an existing change:
  - increment the version number in the changeset ID
  - do NOT modify previously executed changesets (append-only history)

---

### DATA MODEL RULES

* Every entity MUST include an id field
* Entities MUST extend the BaseEntity
* No entity may define its own primary key structure
